<thought>I'll search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, when applied to the target molecule, break an S‑Cl bond and form an N‑S bond (sulfonamide formation). I will omit functional group filters since the available list does not include “S‑Cl”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
